line.comment: 1.211 em line box. Room above the cap height holds two stacked Vietnamese marks (Ế, Ổ) without clipping; win metrics are taken from real glyph bounds at build time.

curves.comment: Tension measured against the tangent intersection; 0.5523 is a true circle. Outer curves are a touch firmer than circular and counters follow them a hair rounder, so the stroke keeps its weight round the bowl instead of thinning at the diagonals.

Light.comment: Light from the Regular -> Light change measured on SF Pro (opsz 17) and Inter (opsz 14) at 300/400 (rasters, x-height normalised; Helvetica Light sits near 200 and is left out). Unlike Bold, Light is not on the Regular -> Bold line: SF and Inter thin horizontals as much as verticals (contrast kept) and keep advances (x0.98-1.00), so the counters open. Strokes: stems x0.78 (cap stem x0.76, figure stem x0.77), round sides x0.77, round tops x0.78, arch x0.79, bars x0.77, e bar x0.79, diagonals x0.81; marks and punctuation thin with the stem (x0.78). Widths: Regular + g x (Light - Regular stem), g = SF/Inter mean per shape (n 0.55, m 0.65, o 0.5, c 0.7, e 0.4, a 0.8, d 0.65, s 0.75, r 0.85, t 1.0, f 1.0, v 0.8, w 0.4, x 0.55, y 0.85, z 0.6, k 1.3, H 0.8, N 0.55, M 0.75, U 0.65, J 0.6, K 1.2, E F 0.6, L 0.5, T 0.45, Z 0.6, B 0.75, P 0.9, R 0.95, D 0.55, O 0.5, G 0.55, C 0.4, S 0.7, A V 0.7, W 0.8, X 0.85, Y 0.7, figure 0.5); tabular advance x0.995. Sidebearings x1.06. Dots shrink less than stems (dot/stem x1.12), mark dots x1.05, mark width x0.94. Apertures as measured: c opens x1.11 (terminals x1.11), e x1.18 (lower terminal 0.485), figures and ? barely (terminalClose -0.005); C a s S keep their Regular cuts (G shares C's cut and stays, where SF/Inter open it x1.08). Joins sit lower as on SF and Inter Light: bowl join 0.81, shoulder join 0.82, bowl crotch 0.575.

Bold.comment: Derived from Regular by the Regular→Bold change measured on SF Pro, Inter and Helvetica rasters (x-height units): stems ×1.62, round sides ×1.65, round tops and shoulders ×1.45, capital bars ×1.49, lowercase bars ×1.36, diagonals ×1.6, marks ×1.35. Body width = Regular + g × added stem weight, g per letter shape from the mean of SF and Inter (n 1.0, o 0.6, d 0.75, H 0.75, O 0.45 …). Sidebearings ×0.85. Joins: shoulder tangent 62° and crotch 0.60; the bowl keeps Regular's crotch, as SF, Helvetica and Inter keep theirs at 0.62 x-height in every weight.

Black.comment: Derived from Bold by the Bold→Black change measured on SF Pro (opsz 17, wght 700→1000) and Inter (opsz 14, 700→900) outlines, x-height units, mean of the two: stems ×1.35–1.36, round sides ×1.36, round tops ×1.29 (o) / ×1.31 (O), arch ×1.29 (follows the round tops, as in Bold), capital bars ×1.31, lowercase bars ×1.30, e bar ×1.19, diagonals ×1.31–1.35, M stem ×1.35, figures ×1.30–1.36, marks ×1.24, B waist ×1.20, punctuation ×1.33, hair strokes keep Bold's share of the stem change (×1.24). Body width = Bold + g × added stem, g measured between 700 and 900 (n 0.97, o 0.61, H 0.75, O 0.44, r 0.95 …); tabular advance ×1.056; sidebearings ×0.82 (SF/Inter n 0.83, H 0.82, o 0.78). Shapes keep the measured Bold→Black change of the openings: c and e apertures ×0.73 / ×0.78, counters of A e a æ ×0.63 / 0.51 / 0.45 / 0.48 of Bold (SF/Inter 0.65 / 0.50 / 0.49–0.55 / 0.50–0.54), so the A bar (aBarUpper) and the e bar (barLowerE) drop and the a bowl (aBowlTop) rises; the s terminals stop at the oval extremes (sTerminal 0), so s stays 8 % more open than SF/Inter. Dots: i dot ÷ stem 0.85 on SF/Inter → dotDiameter 0.93. Superiors (ª º) are the plain scaled letters (superiorWeight 0.62), still a touch heavier than Bold's. Symbols whose fixed size would close (% & @ ° € ß, B/R bowls) carry counter minimums in their recipes that only bind in Black.

instances.comment: Weights between the masters are interpolated from the masters' own parameters, not drawn: every stroke, shape, proportion, spacing and curve value is Regular + t (Bold - Regular) with t = (wght - 400) / (700 - 400), and the same recipes run on the result. SF and Inter put 500 at t 0.29-0.38 on every measured stroke, aperture and advance (rasters, x-height normalised), i.e. linear in wght, so Medium uses t = 1/3. Medium also serves CSS weight 600 (UI semibold): declare its face as font-weight 500 600, otherwise browsers pick Bold for 600. Strokes, widths and spacing round to whole units, shapes to 4 decimals.

shapes.comment: Ratios: bar heights are fractions of cap/x-height, join heights fractions of x-height, terminal cuts fractions of the bowl radius from its centre. a: aHookLeft is a fraction of the letter width, aBowlCorner of the bowl width, aBowlSlope is in degrees. Joins of the bowl (b d p q g) and the shoulder (n h m u r) follow SF Pro (opsz 17 and 28), Helvetica Neue and Inter of the same weight within 0.01 x-height at seven distances, 0.005-0.12 x-height from the stem edge (rasters): outer join 0.83 with a 64° (bowl) / 66° (shoulder) tangent, bowl crotch 0.585 and shoulder crotch 0.625 leaving at 82° / 265°. The bowl arms therefore swell to 1.3-1.6 stems at the stem and the counters stay oval; the earlier 0.88 / 76° / 0.72 made D-shaped counters.

proportions.comment: Body widths (outer extremes, font units) at Regular. n:o:H:O = 0.77 : 0.88 : 1 : 1.16.

spacing.comment: Sidebearings by edge shape. Round = 0.63 x straight, diagonal = 0.1 x straight; terminals sit between. Bowls 0.57 x straight, open arms/bars/hooks by the white they enclose.

opticalSizing.comment: Spacing-only opsz at each of the five fixed weights, and the opsz axis of the variable font. Values are optical-size coordinates (points); browser auto mapping is tested separately. Text spacing is unchanged through 16; full Display spacing at 48 and above. No outline scaling or stroke changes.

variable.comment: One variable font with wght and opsz. Masters: Light 300, Regular 400, Medium 500 (the parametric instance, so the axis passes through the static Medium), Bold 700, Black 900, each at Text 16 and Display 48 spacing (see opticalSizing). avar holds weight 600 on 500: SemiBold is Medium, exactly as the static faces serve CSS 600 with Medium. Design coordinates put Medium at 525 and Bold at 712.5, i.e. normalised 0.25 and 0.625: CSS 500 and 700 normalise to 0.2 and 0.6, which F2Dot14 cannot hold, and HarfBuzz then landed one step past Bold (advances off by 1 unit); exact dyadic peaks and a plateau of one F2Dot14 step (±0.03) round 500 and 700 make every renderer hit the masters. 800 interpolates Bold → Black. Overlaps are kept (OVERLAP_SIMPLE / OVERLAP_COMPOUND set), because independent unions per weight cannot interpolate.

identity.rule: Every terminal is cut exactly horizontal (c, e, s, a, 2) or exactly vertical (r, t, 1). No diagonal or rounded ends.

Bowls use tension 0.59 outside and 0.58 inside (circle = 0.552): the counter follows the outline, so the stroke keeps 0.94 of its side weight at the diagonals; apertures close like SF (c 0.39 x-height) and s has a shallow spine, so letters read as round forms, not pen strokes.

Regular bowls and shoulders join the stem at 0.83 x-height, with 64° and 66° tangents respectively. Bowl and shoulder crotches are 0.585 and 0.625 x-height. Light and Bold apply their master overrides. These rounded joins replace the earlier D-shaped counters; optical spacing translates whole glyphs without changing these shapes.

identity.trait: Vietnamese marks drawn in the same pen
identity.rule: Marks share one stroke (markStroke 158) and the full-round curve and sit 152 units over the x-height; after a circumflex the acute, grave and hook rise from 92 % of its height on its upper right with a solved 44-unit clearance; the horn is a level shelf turning into an upright stub cut horizontally at 1.24 x-height.

mono.comment: Porto Faifo Mono: the same pen, metrics and curves on one fixed advance of 1180 units (0.576 em, a touch under Menlo, JetBrains Mono and Fira Code at 0.6). Body widths are redrawn to fit the cell: capitals narrow to 0.63-0.89 of the cell, lowercase keeps n and o near their proportional widths, m w M W narrow with a lighter middle so they do not darken the line. The narrow letters i j l f t I 1 get the spurs, slabs and tails that fill the cell and tell 1 l I i apart, r a wider arch; zero carries the slash by default. No kerning, no ligatures.
mono.penComment: Each Mono style is drawn with its own pen, a weight interpolated between the masters, and named by its weight class. Regular (400) uses the wght 406 pen: a code line inks 34.4 per unit width at equal x-height, about JetBrains Mono Regular (33.3), under Porto Faifo Sans UI text (41.1). Medium (500) uses the wght 470 pen: 37.8 before the join fixes, about JetBrains and SF Mono Medium (36.0).

slab.comment: Regular units. The spur reaches left from the stem top of i j l f; the slab is the foot of i, the cap slab the top and foot of I and the foot of 1, centred on the cell.
